source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 230 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 230 was established by Ordinance No. 19070, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 19, 1986. Ordinance No. 19070 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 230 is established on property generally fronting on the east line of Preston Road, north of the north line of Hughes Lane. The size of PD 230 is approximately 0.72 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved development plan. [Note: This plan could not be located in city files.] (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.105. USES.

The only use permitted on the Property is an electrical substation. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the city plan commission-approved landscape plan (Exhibit 230B). All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. If the landscaping shown on the landscape plan ceases to exist or is not maintained, a new landscape plan must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission and the landscaping installed within six months of the approval. If the landscaping is not installed within six months, the building official shall revoke the certificate of occupancy for the electrical substation. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.107. PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.108. PAVING.

All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.109. HEIGHT.

No structure may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.110. SETBACKS.

All front, rear, and side yard minimum setback requirements are as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.111. SCREENING.

An eight-foot-high solid screening wall must be constructed and maintained as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.112. MAINTENANCE.

The entire premises must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.113. SIGNS.

The only permitted signs on the Property are five premise signs. No individual sign may exceed 10 inches by 18 inches. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Underground Utilities
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.114. UNDERGROUND UTILITIES.

All electrical lines entering or leaving the electrical substation must be located underground. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Alternate Development Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.115. ALTERNATE DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS.

The following use regulations and development standards apply to this PD if no electrical substation is developed:

(1) Development plan. No development plan is necessary for development of the Property for single-family uses.

(2) Uses. The only permitted use on the Property is single-family.

(3) R-16 district standards. Development of the Property must fully comply with all requirements of single-family development set forth in the Dallas Development Code for an R-10 Single- family District. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.116. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-230.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 230 is located on Zoning Map No. C-7. (Ord. Nos. 19070; 25711)
